name: Flaring or use of landfill gas
description: Large-scale methodology for capturing landfill gas and flaring it or using it for energy.
formula: ER_y = (MD_PJ,y − MD_BL,y) × GWP_CH4 + EG_PJ,y × CEF_elec,y + ET_PJ,y × CEF_ther,y − PE_y

parameters.name: Global warming potential of methane
parameters.description: Value prescribed by the programme for the crediting period

applicability: Landfill gas capture with flaring and/or energy use
Baseline methane destruction (e.g. regulatory) accounted for
sourceRef: UNFCCC CDM ACM0001 v19.0 (version per BioCarbon Standard CDM waste-sector list, Feb 2024; may have been superseded)

name: Landfill methane recovery
description: Small-scale recovery and destruction or use of methane from landfills.
formula: BE_CH4,y = (MD_PJ,y − MD_BL,y) × GWP_CH4;  ER_y = BE_y − PE_y − LE_y

parameters.name: Emission reductions
parameters.description: Net emission reductions in year y

parameters.name: Global warming potential of methane
parameters.description: Value prescribed by the programme for the crediting period

applicability: Landfill methane recovery by flaring or energy use
Small-scale CDM Type III limit: emission reductions ≤ 60 ktCO2e per year

name: Solid waste disposal: first-order decay (FOD) methane
description: IPCC first-order decay model for CH4 from solid waste disposal sites.
formula: DDOCm = W × DOC × DOC_f × MCF;  DDOCm_accum,T = DDOCm_d,T + DDOCm_accum,T−1 × e^(−k);  CH4_gen = DDOCm_decomp × F × 16/12;  CH4_emitted = (ΣCH4_gen − R) × (1 − OX)
applicability: Solid waste disposal sites (Tier 1 or 2)
Guidance methodology, not a crediting programme
